mapper.insert: insert into project_record ( project_record_no, project_no, project_record_writer_no, project_record_type, project_record_title, project_record_content ) values( #{projectRecordNo}, #{projectNo}, #{projectRecordWriterNo}, #{projectRecordType}, #{projectRecordTitle}, #{projectRecordContent} )
mapper.select:
select pr.project_record_no, pr.project_record_type, pr.project_record_title, pr.project_record_writer_no, e.emp_name project_record_writer_name, pr.project_record_ctime, pr.project_record_utime, pri.issue_status project_record_issue_status
from project_record pr
join project_member pm on pr.project_record_writer_no = pm.project_member_no
join emp e on pm.emp_no = e.emp_no
left outer join project_record_issue pri on pr.project_record_no = pri.project_record_no
where pr.project_no = #{projectNo}
order by pr.project_record_no desc

select pr.project_record_no, pr.project_no, pr.project_record_type, pr.project_record_title, pr.project_record_content, pr.project_record_writer_no, writer.emp_name project_record_writer_name, pr.project_record_modifier_no, modifier.emp_name project_record_modifier_name, pr.project_record_ctime, pr.project_record_utime, pri.issue_status project_record_issue_status, pri.issue_resolution, pri.issue_resolved_at
from project_record pr
join project_member writer_pm on pr.project_record_writer_no = writer_pm.project_member_no
join emp writer on writer_pm.emp_no = writer.emp_no
left outer join project_member modifier_pm on pr.project_record_modifier_no = modifier_pm.project_member_no
left outer join emp modifier on modifier_pm.emp_no = modifier.emp_no
left outer join project_record_issue pri on pr.project_record_no = pri.project_record_no
where pr.project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}

select 'TASK' related_type, t.task_no related_no, t.task_title related_title, t.task_status related_status
from project_record_task prt join task t on prt.task_no = t.task_no
where prt.project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}
union all
select 'MESSAGE' related_type, cm.chat_message_no related_no, cm.chat_message_content related_title, null related_status
from project_record_message prm join chat_message cm on prm.chat_message_no = cm.chat_message_no
where prm.project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}
union all
select 'NOTE' related_type, n.note_no related_no, n.note_title related_title, null related_status
from project_record_note prn join note n on prn.note_no = n.note_no
where prn.project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}
union all
select 'ATTACH' related_type, a.attach_no related_no, a.attach_name related_title, null related_status
from project_record_attach pra join attach a on pra.attach_no = a.attach_no
where pra.project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}
mapper.update: update project_record set project_record_title = #{projectRecordTitle}, project_record_content = #{projectRecordContent}, project_record_modifier_no = #{projectRecordModifierNo}, project_record_utime = systimestamp where project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}

update project_record_issue set issue_status = 'RESOLVED', issue_resolution = #{issueResolution}, issue_resolved_at = systimestamp where project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo} and issue_status = 'OPEN'
update project_record_issue set issue_status = 'OPEN', issue_resolution = null, issue_resolved_at = null where project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo} and issue_status = 'RESOLVED'
update project_record set project_record_modifier_no = #{projectRecordModifierNo}, project_record_utime = systimestamp where project_record_no = #{projectRecordNo}
